actual_blocker: B Docker 20.10.24+dfsg1 with cgroup v2 does not expose --cgroup-conf. V1 mistakenly assumed this CLI capability. No container was created.

proposed_changes.memory_oom_group: Observe and record the existing kernel value 0 or 1; do not write/force it, and do not claim atomic OOM group kill
proposed_changes.docker_cli: Remove the unsupported --cgroup-conf requirement; use standard resource/namespace flags only
proposed_changes.failure_cleanup: Keep mandatory process-group kill/reap/empty verification and external exact-container stop on failure/timeout; this is not a claim about tested OOM behavior

image_freeze_next: Only choose an image already in the bounded 32 observed records and project its immutable ID/command/volumes metadata before freeze. No new image list or Python-capability claim from a name alone.
authority_boundary: The existing approval explicitly required OOM group=1. Do not silently substitute this v2 under that approval. Local implementation/tests/review may complete; actual v2 container requires approval of this precise amendment.
